downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.57.10，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.57.10. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 训练页面板自由停靠：「交易与历史」「下单」「Mentor AI」可以拖到图表的左、右、下方或并排摆放，布局按电脑记住，右键标题栏可恢复默认。
highlights.en: Dockable training panels: drag Trades & history, Order and Mentor AI to the left, right or bottom of the chart, or side by side; each computer remembers its layout, and right-clicking a title bar restores the default.

highlights.zh: 快捷键 Q 显示或收起下单面板，看历史时一按就回到下单面板；快捷键 1 显示或收起「交易与历史」，两个键都能在设置里改。
highlights.en: Press Q to show or collapse the order panel, which also brings it back from History, and 1 to show or collapse Trades & history; both keys can be changed in Settings.

highlights.zh: 锁定画线：画线照常显示，但不能选中或拖动，拖动旁边的止损、止盈和挂单线时不会误拖画线。
highlights.en: Lock drawings: they stay on the chart but cannot be selected or moved, so stop, target and pending-order lines next to them are easy to drag.

highlights.zh: 画线时右键取消：画到一半点右键只去掉这一个图形，开着保持绘图模式时可以接着画，不再落点或弹出挂单菜单。
highlights.en: Right-click cancels the shape being drawn instead of placing a point and opening the pending-order menu; in stay-in-drawing mode you keep drawing.
